sources.snippet: Franka Real-Robot Final Checkpoints This public repository contains the final compact PyTorch checkpoints from the Franka real-robot finetuning runs found under checkpoints/realrobot on the CVLAB1 workspace. The upload keeps one highest-step compact .pt file for each robot-* run that still had a compact checkpoint on disk.
